headline: TransDigm Group (TDG) Stock Still Appears Undervalued As 5 Year Gain Hits 111%
summary: TransDigm Group has delivered a powerful long term share price run, yet the recent pullback this year raises a simple question for anyone looking at the stock today. Do the cash flows that the business can generate over time support a market value at this level, based on a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) view of its intrinsic value?
